snippet.title: Dice Gambit - Official Demo Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Shape and lead your own fully customizable (and debt-ridden) family of Inquisitors in charge of hunting the chromatic monsters infesting the city of Neo-Talis.

As your inquisitors cleanse the city, they will unlock unique abilities and grow more powerful until they retire - or die. Gain favors by hanging out with eccentric nobles, learning the city's secrets, and occasionally delivering ice cream!
